title: RBI Recognises 'Sahamati' as Self-Regulatory Organisation for Account Aggregator Ecosystem
summary: Sahamati becomes official SRO for NBFC-Account Aggregator network powering consent-based data sharing.

blocks.content: Sahamati becomes official SRO for NBFC-Account Aggregator network powering consent-based data sharing.

items: SRO Recognition: RBI recognised Sahamati (not-for-profit entity) as SRO for Account Aggregator ecosystem.
AA Framework: Consent-based financial data sharing launched Sept 2, 2021; enabled ₹3.5 lakh crore lending in FY26.
